subject.title: fix(browser): prove post-action target continuity before adopting a tab

question: Should OpenClaw accept this narrower route-level heuristic, or require the backend-owned target-outcome refactor described by the canonical report before changing browser target continuity?
rationale: The correct durable owner spans three backend models and determines whether a stale target should be returned, rejected, or represented by a stable relay handle; that API and compatibility boundary cannot be selected safely by automated repair.

options.title: Require backend-owned outcomes
options.body: Refactor managed Playwright, extension relay, and Chrome MCP to return or preserve the exact operation target, then remove resolver-based replacement selection.

options.title: Accept bounded heuristic
options.body: Merge the current narrower behavior while explicitly accepting remaining false-adoption risk outside the two demonstrated scenarios.

recommendation.title: Require backend-owned outcomes
recommendation.body: Refactor managed Playwright, extension relay, and Chrome MCP to return or preserve the exact operation target, then remove resolver-based replacement selection.

likelyOwner.reason: The canonical open report contains the cross-backend ownership design and acceptance matrix needed to choose the contract.
